results.author: Guru Arjan Dev Ji (M5)
results.en: His Naam is True, and True are those who meditate on it.

results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
results.translit: jap man sat naam sadaa sat naam
results.en: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.

results.author: Bhatt Mathura (ਭਟ)
results.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਉਰਿ ॥
results.translit: sat roop sat naam sat santokh dhario ur
results.en: He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.

results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.en: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.

results.author: Guru Ram Das Ji (M4)
results.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
results.translit: sat sat satigur naam dirhaaiaa ras gaae gun paramaanandaa
results.en: The True Guru has implanted the True Name of the True Lord within me; I sing His Glorious Praises, and taste the supreme ecstasy. ||1||Pause||
